problems: The card omits the central structural decision: there should be one implementation, in QThreadData::clearEvents(), and QCoreApplicationPrivate::cleanupThreadData() should use it. The card only lists the two sites, so the engineer could fix them separately and leave duplicated logic.

The card says to drain events that the destructors post, but it leaves out that the drain must be bounded by a maximum number of passes. ~QEvent() can run arbitrary code that keeps posting events, and reviewers (Reviewer 08) treated the MaxPasses limit, and a comment explaining it, as the part that actually matters. An unbounded drain could loop forever at exit.
